response.sql: WITH type_counts AS (SELECT o.ordertune, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders AS o WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM riskandmargin AS r WHERE r.ordervault = o.recordvault) GROUP BY o.ordertune), average_count AS (SELECT AVG(order_count) AS avg_count FROM type_counts) SELECT a.avg_count AS average_count, AVG(t.order_count - a.avg_count) AS average_excess FROM type_counts AS t CROSS JOIN average_count AS a WHERE t.order_count > a.avg_count;
